_note: Pinned real events + stable invariants for the v2 app-view regression suite (scripts/regression-check.ts). PIN only what should never change: a pinned event's id/kind/pubkey/created_at/content-hash, envelope structure, registry rule names, privacy invariants. NEVER pin volatile values: aggregate counts, rankings, reply sets, follower edges' truth values, profile kind-0 contents (replaceable). Discovered live against https://nagg-production.up.railway.app on 2026-07-05, nagg branch v2 @ a068020. Re-pin only on an INTENTIONAL contract change (see docs/regression-suite.md).

registry._note: The aggregate vocabulary clients may ever see. Event-keyed names from internal/rules/defaults.go (CanonicalName) plus the rollup's vertex_-prefixed gated variants (internal/clickhouse/read.go); pubkey-keyed names from internal/appview/envelope.go pubkeyAggregates. A key outside these sets means the registry contract changed.

knownIssues._note: REAL SERVER BUG present at pinning time, reported 2026-07-05: internal/clickhouse/read.go BatchPubkeyStats still SELECTs `argMax(followers, computed_at)` from pubkey_stats, but migration 019_terminology.sql renamed the columns to k3_out/k3_in/k1_1111_authored. Every route that calls BatchPubkeyStats 500s in prod (/nostr/follows, /nostr/profile, /nostr/own/profiles). Checks matching this signature report XFAIL (tracked, non-gating) so the suite stays usable as a deploy gate; when the fix ships they flip to PASS and this entry must be deleted.

thread._note: User-chosen thread root (2026-07-03, kind-7-referenced so retention-protected). Pinned exactly: id/kind/pubkey/created_at/sha256(content). Volatile, asserted as presence classes only: the reply SET (>=1 kind-1/1111 e-tagging the root must persist — events here are never deleted), aggregate counts, reply ranking.

feedAuthors._note: jack — high-fanout account; the pinned kind-1 is 200+ days old and heavily kind-7/kind-9735-referenced, so the 1y-unreferenced retention rule can never prune it. until = createdAt+1 windows the feed page over it.
feedAuthors.label: jack

feedAuthors._note: gigi — well-referenced kind-1 (kind-7 + kind-9735 + kind-6/16 references recorded), ~1 month old at pinning.
feedAuthors.label: gigi

events._note: kind-1 (jack's, also the feed + aggregates fixture target). Content pinned by hash — events are immutable.
kind-7 referencing the pinned kind-1 (content '+'). Kind-7 has NO lifetime rule — kept forever.
kind-9735 zap receipt referencing the pinned kind-1 (empty content — sha256 of ''). Kind-9735 has NO lifetime rule — kept forever.

aggregatesTarget._note: A long-referenced event: k7_e and k9735_e keys must EXIST with value >= 1 (references accumulate; the aggregate ledger outlives referencing events, so presence can never regress). Exact counts are volatile — never pinned.

viewers._note: Viewer-keyed fixtures. notificationsViewer = an active known viewer (the pinned thread's root author) whose feed had 20+ entries and hasNext at pinning time. The notifications read model keeps 14 DAYS of rows — if this account goes dormant the presence assertion starts failing; re-pin to another active viewer, that is fixture drift, not a server regression.
viewers._notePolicy: policy=RELAXED is pinned because the default (stricter) policy legitimately score-gates this viewer's entries to zero; the presence class 'entries non-empty' is only stable on the relaxed policy.

search._note: Structure-only: result ranking and membership are volatile, and the gold path depends on Vertex DVM credits. A 5xx naming vertex/DVM is a SKIP, not a FAIL. The local-index fallback normally keeps this route 200 even with the DVM down.

recommended._note: Vertex-credit-dependent (no local fallback): a 5xx is a SKIP, not a FAIL. Structure asserted only when it answers 200.

mint._note: Non-envelope routes: assert 200 + parseable + top-level shape only. Review counts/mint sets are volatile.

rankedFeedInput._note: Minimal live ranked input (same map GraphQL rankedEvents accepts). sinceHoursAgo is resolved to a unix timestamp at run time — ranking output is fully volatile, so only envelope structure and orderBy:'rank' are asserted.

capabilities._note: appViewVersion is pinned; the advertised route list doubles as the did-we-forget-an-endpoint check — every advertised route must be covered by at least one check in scripts/regression-check.ts, and the runner fails if a NEW route appears without coverage.
